summary.text: Troy Downing is the Republican incumbent seeking a second term in Montana's 2nd Congressional District. A technology and insurance entrepreneur and Air Force and Air National Guard veteran, he served as Montana State Auditor from 2021 to 2025 before his election to the U.S. House in 2024. He serves on the House Financial Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: Troy Downing was raised in Indio, California, and studied computer science at New York University, where, according to his official biography, he worked as a research scientist and teacher in the university's IT department.

He co-founded WebCal, an internet-based calendar system incorporated into Yahoo in 1998, and moved to Montana after its sale; his official biography says he later mentored and financed other startups as an angel investor.

After the September 11, 2001 attacks he enlisted in the U.S. Air Force and Air National Guard, serving eight years with a Combat Search and Rescue squadron (the 129th Rescue Squadron, per Ballotpedia) with two tours in Afghanistan.
Downing was also CEO of AC Self Storage Solutions, operated a commercial real estate development firm, and founded a commercial insurance company.
Downing ran unsuccessfully in the 2018 Republican primary for U.S. Senate in Montana.

In 2020 he won election as Montana Commissioner of Securities and Insurance (State Auditor) after defeating two opponents in the Republican primary, and he served from 2021 to 2025; in that role he also sat on the state Board of Land Commissioners.
He won the 2nd Congressional District seat in 2024, took office on January 3, 2025, and sits on the House Financial Services Committee.
Downing remains involved with Montana veterans' organizations; Ballotpedia lists him as a member of the Montana Veterans of Foreign Wars and a volunteer with the Warriors and Quiet Waters Foundation.
His official biography says he lives in Helena with his wife, Heather, and that they have four grown children.
